items.name: Cloud Foundry runtime
items.use: Run supported application and worker workloads with a managed application model.
items.boundary: Choose for an app requirement; it does not include every database or SaaS subscription.

items.name: Kyma runtime
items.use: Run container workloads needing Kubernetes-specific control or ecosystem integration.
items.boundary: Managed cluster does not remove responsibility for images, workloads, exposure and operations.

items.name: SAP BTP ABAP environment
items.use: Build side-by-side ABAP Cloud applications and RAP services.
items.boundary: Separate from S/4HANA; ERP access is remote, not direct local-table access.

items.name: SAP Build
items.use: Select the relevant application-development and automation offering.
items.boundary: An umbrella/offer, not a fourth runtime; check the actual included capabilities and usage rights.

items.name: SAP Build Code
items.use: Use an integrated, AI-assisted development offering for supported application scenarios.
items.boundary: Development package and tools do not replace runtime, identity or business-system entitlements.

items.name: SAP Business Application Studio
items.use: Use managed development environments and SAP application tooling.
items.boundary: Design time, not production hosting; a supported local IDE may be sufficient.

items.name: Cloud Application Programming Model — CAP
items.use: Model domain data and implement Node.js or Java services.
items.boundary: A programming model; CF/Kyma, persistence and identity are separate decisions.

items.name: ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model — RAP
items.use: Implement transactional ABAP business objects and services.
items.boundary: A programming model within a supported ABAP target, not its own BTP subscription.

items.name: SAPUI5
items.use: Build SAP-oriented web user interfaces and custom interactions.
items.boundary: Frontend library; backend logic and authorisation remain separate.

items.name: SAP Fiori elements
items.use: Generate standard floorplan-based experiences from service metadata and annotations.
items.boundary: Use when the floorplan fits; it does not eliminate UX or backend design.

items.name: HTML5 Application Repository
items.use: Store and serve versioned static web application content through a supported entry pattern.
items.boundary: Not a Node.js/Java execution runtime or a business database.

items.name: UI Flexibility service
items.use: Provide supported UI adaptation and personalisation persistence.
items.boundary: Conditional on the app scenario; formerly UI5 Flexibility for Key Users.

items.name: SAP Build Work Zone, standard edition
items.use: Provide a role-oriented entry point to business applications.
items.boundary: Not mandatory for every UI; app hosting, routing and backend permissions still matter.

items.name: SAP Build Work Zone, advanced edition
items.use: Provide a broader workspace, content and collaboration experience.
items.boundary: Do not buy the advanced experience for a single simple launch page without a requirement.

items.name: SAP Task Center
items.use: Aggregate supported tasks into a common inbox.
items.boundary: Task providers own processing and approval semantics; provider/plan compatibility matters.

items.name: SAP Mobile Services
items.use: Provide selected onboarding, connectivity, offline, push and mobile-management capabilities.
items.boundary: Capabilities and supported clients depend on configuration and plan; not an ERP backend.

items.name: Mobile Development Kit — MDK
items.use: Build metadata-driven native business applications with supported mobile/offline features.
items.boundary: Client/application approach, not another synonym for Mobile Services.

items.name: SAP BTP SDK for iOS
items.use: Implement native iOS apps using supported SAP mobile libraries.
items.boundary: Requires native skills, app lifecycle, signing and feature-specific backend setup.

items.name: SAP BTP SDK for Android
items.use: Implement native Android apps using supported SAP mobile libraries.
items.boundary: Requires native engineering and testing on actual target devices.

items.name: Joule Work mobile app (formerly SAP Mobile Start)
items.use: Offer mobile access to supported enterprise content, apps, tasks and notifications.
items.boundary: An entry application, not a generic SDK for developing arbitrary offline workflows.

items.name: SAP Integration Suite
items.use: Select a managed integration platform with the required capabilities.
items.boundary: The product name does not prove that every capability or runtime is licensed/enabled.

items.name: Cloud Integration
items.use: Build iFlows for mediation, adapters, mapping and integration error handling.
items.boundary: Conditional: a simple direct supported API call may not need an iFlow.

items.name: API Management
items.use: Publish and govern APIs with proxies, policies and consumer-oriented controls.
items.boundary: Does not replace application business authorisation or complex process orchestration.

items.name: API Composition / Graph capabilities
items.use: Expose a supported, composed or connected business API view.
items.boundary: Check current naming, edition and supported entities; not a universal virtual ERP.

items.name: Open Connectors
items.use: Use supported connectors to simplify selected third-party SaaS integrations.
items.boundary: Check connector coverage and commercial scope; not every external API is supported.

items.name: Integration Advisor
items.use: Define integration/message implementation guidelines and mapping guidance.
items.boundary: Useful for complex business/B2B standards; not the runtime that delivers every message.

items.name: Trading Partner Management
items.use: Manage B2B partner integration agreements and configuration.
items.boundary: Conditional on partner/B2B needs; no reason to add it to a single internal API.

items.name: Integration Assessment
items.use: Assess interface needs and select integration approaches using a structured method.
items.boundary: Assessment support, not automatic implementation of the architecture.

items.name: Migration Assessment
items.use: Assess supported legacy integration assets for migration planning.
items.boundary: An assessment is not a guarantee of automatic, behaviour-preserving migration.

items.name: Cloud Integration Automation service
items.use: Guide supported integration setup tasks across participating products.
items.boundary: A guided setup service, not Cloud Integration message-processing runtime.

items.name: Edge Integration Cell
items.use: Run supported integration workloads in a customer-managed environment.
items.boundary: Requires its own supported infrastructure and operations; cloud control dependencies remain.

items.name: Event Mesh in SAP Integration Suite
items.use: Provide application messaging and event-based extension integration.
items.boundary: Check the suite edition, service instance and queue/client setup; distinguish the standalone legacy offer.

items.name: SAP Integration Suite, advanced event mesh
items.use: Build broader event-broker/mesh landscapes across clouds and locations.
items.boundary: Check its explicit commercial scope and broker sizing; do not assume inclusion in every suite plan.

items.name: SAP Cloud Application Event Hub
items.use: Distribute events among supported SAP cloud applications and extension scenarios.
items.boundary: Supported participants/formations matter; not interchangeable with any general-purpose queue broker.

items.name: SAP Master Data Integration
items.use: Distribute supported master-data objects across applications.
items.boundary: Replication is not master-data approval/governance and does not settle data ownership.

items.name: Destination service
items.use: Centralise supported endpoint and authentication configuration for consumers.
items.boundary: Not a message mapper, VPN, or automatic grant of business permissions.

items.name: Connectivity service
items.use: Provide supported access paths, including relevant private-network connectivity.
items.boundary: Use the setup for the selected runtime and protocol, not a copied CF-only recipe.

items.name: SAP Cloud Connector
items.use: Expose approved private-network resources through a controlled outbound connection.
items.boundary: Installed in the private landscape; not required for every public cloud API.

items.name: SAP Private Link service
items.use: Connect to supported private hyperscaler endpoints.
items.boundary: Provider, region and target restrictions apply; not a universal on-premise tunnel.

items.name: SAP Service Manager
items.use: Manage service brokers, instances and bindings across supported environments.
items.boundary: A service-consumption/control facility, not the business application runtime.

items.name: SAP BTP service operator
items.use: Manage BTP service instances and bindings through Kubernetes resources.
items.boundary: Requires configuration and appropriate permissions; does not entitle an unavailable service.

items.name: Connectivity Proxy
items.use: Provide the relevant Kubernetes connectivity path for supported private access.
items.boundary: Runtime integration component, not a replacement for backend access controls.

items.name: Transparent Proxy
items.use: Simplify destination-based outbound consumption in supported Kubernetes setups.
items.boundary: Check modules and authentication support; not universal automatic token forwarding.

items.name: SAP Cloud SDK
items.use: Help application code consume supported APIs, destinations and connectivity.
items.boundary: Library/tooling rather than an integration platform or separately deployed ERP adapter.

items.name: SAP Credential Store
items.use: Store and consume supported secrets through controlled service access.
items.boundary: Conditional on credential needs; not an identity provider or a place for public client secrets.

items.name: Custom Domain service
items.use: Use a supported custom domain/certificate setup for application entry points.
items.boundary: DNS, certificates and renewal ownership remain; optional for a technical pilot.

items.name: SAP Cloud Identity Services
items.use: Select the required cloud identity capabilities and trust integration.
items.boundary: An identity portfolio; application and ERP authorisation still require design.

items.name: Identity Authentication — IAS
items.use: Authenticate users and federate with the selected corporate identity provider.
items.boundary: Login is not user provisioning or record-level authorisation.

items.name: Identity Provisioning — IPS
items.use: Synchronise identities and assignments through supported source/target systems.
items.boundary: Provisioning jobs do not authenticate each application request.

items.name: Identity Directory
items.use: Manage identity data in the supported cloud identity architecture.
items.boundary: A directory, not automatic access to all business systems.

items.name: Authorization Management
items.use: Use supported policy-based authorisation with the chosen application model.
items.boundary: Confirm runtime/framework integration; not a mandatory extra layer alongside every XSUAA app.

items.name: Authorization and Trust Management — XSUAA
items.use: Provide token/authorisation integration for supported BTP application models.
items.boundary: Scopes and role collections do not replace backend or tenant/object permissions.

items.name: SaaS Provisioning service
items.use: Register/onboard supported multitenant SaaS consumers and lifecycle callbacks.
items.boundary: Conditional on SaaS tenancy; business data isolation and offboarding are application responsibilities.

items.name: SAP Audit Log service
items.use: Record and consume relevant security/audit events with controlled access.
items.boundary: Not the same as application debug logs or proof that a business transaction committed.

name: Operational data, documents and master data

items.name: SAP HANA Cloud
items.use: Persist and query application data with the required HANA capabilities.
items.boundary: Select capacity/features for a real need; not mandatory for a stateless extension.

items.name: HANA HDI containers
items.use: Isolate and deploy application database artifacts within the supported HANA setup.
items.boundary: A container is not a separately provisioned full HANA Cloud database.

items.name: PostgreSQL on SAP BTP, hyperscaler option
items.use: Use managed relational persistence where its feature/support model fits.
items.boundary: Check region, plan, CAP/runtime support and operational requirements.

items.name: Redis on SAP BTP, hyperscaler option
items.use: Cache disposable data for fast access in a supported setup.
items.boundary: Do not make it the only business record; design cache rebuild and service-specific persistence limits.

items.name: Object Store on SAP BTP
items.use: Store files and other objects using supported storage integrations.
items.boundary: Document lifecycle and backup/versioning policy are not automatically solved.

items.name: Document Management service, integration option
items.use: Integrate document capabilities into custom applications and supported repositories.
items.boundary: Application integration scope differs from provisioning document storage.

items.name: Document Management service, repository option
items.use: Provide a supported document repository for the selected document architecture.
items.boundary: Check repository capacity, lifecycle, permissions and integration dependencies.

items.name: SAP Forms service by Adobe
items.use: Render supported business forms/documents from templates and data.
items.boundary: Conditional on form-generation needs; not general document AI or document storage.

items.name: SAP Data Quality Management, microservices
items.use: Apply supported data-quality/address-related services to relevant records.
items.boundary: Coverage and operations are service-specific; not automatic global master-data cleansing.

items.name: SAP Master Data Governance, cloud edition
items.use: Provide the governance capabilities/object scope of the selected cloud offering.
items.boundary: Do not equate its scope and configuration with every S/4HANA MDG deployment.

items.name: SAP Datasphere
items.use: Integrate/model data and preserve business semantics for analytics and sharing.
items.boundary: Not the default transactional database for every extension.

items.name: SAP Analytics Cloud
items.use: Deliver analytics, dashboards and planning on suitable data connections/models.
items.boundary: Data preparation, source rights and planning licences remain distinct decisions.

items.name: SAP Business Data Cloud
items.use: Use the relevant governed data-product and analytical solution architecture.
items.boundary: Broader offering with entitlements; not a blanket licence for all BTP services.

items.name: SAP Databricks
items.use: Use its supported data-engineering/AI capabilities within the chosen BDC landscape.
items.boundary: Requires the relevant component scope, connectivity and commercial arrangement.

items.name: SAP Snowflake
items.use: Evaluate supported Snowflake capabilities in the applicable BDC offering.
items.boundary: An additional component with regional/commercial prerequisites, not universal BTP capacity.

items.name: SAP AI Core
items.use: Run/manage supported AI workloads and configured model access.
items.boundary: Resource groups, deployments, credentials, plan and region must match the scenario.

items.name: SAP AI Launchpad
items.use: Manage connected AI runtimes, scenarios and deployments through a UI.
items.boundary: Management surface, not the execution engine or a required hop in every model request.

items.name: Generative AI hub
items.use: Access supported foundation models/orchestration through the applicable AI Core setup.
items.boundary: Requires the documented extended plan; model availability and consumption are separate gates.

items.name: SAP Document AI
items.use: Extract supported information from documents for downstream validation.
items.boundary: Extraction is not authorisation, accounting approval or guaranteed correctness.

items.name: Joule
items.use: Use supported copilot interactions in the relevant SAP product context.
items.boundary: Product availability, user scope and commercial prerequisites are not universal.

items.name: Joule Studio
items.use: Develop supported custom skills/agents for the applicable Joule offering.
items.boundary: Check the specific offering and prerequisites; design-time access is not runtime permission.

items.name: SAP Build Process Automation
items.use: Build supported workflows, forms, decisions and robotic automations.
items.boundary: Keep one business-process owner; use RPA only when the API/process alternative is unsuitable.

items.name: SAP Cloud Logging
items.use: Collect/analyse supported logs, metrics and traces for operations.
items.boundary: Size ingestion and retention; it does not by itself confirm ERP business success.

items.name: Application Logging service
items.use: Use the supported application-logging facility for an existing or selected setup.
items.boundary: Compare scope with Cloud Logging; do not assume the services are identical or automatically migrated.

items.name: Alert Notification service for SAP BTP
items.use: Route relevant events/alerts to the teams and channels that must react.
items.boundary: An alert is not remediation or a hard spending stop.

items.name: SAP Automation Pilot
items.use: Execute controlled operational commands and runbooks.
items.boundary: Operational automation, not the owner of business approvals; bound permissions and destructive actions.

items.name: SAP Job Scheduling service
items.use: Trigger supported scheduled application work.
items.boundary: Worker idempotency, overlap protection and business completion remain your responsibility.

items.name: Application Autoscaler
items.use: Scale supported application instances according to configured policies.
items.boundary: Cannot fix a saturated database, unavailable ERP or uncontrolled retry storm.

items.name: SAP Continuous Integration and Delivery
items.use: Build/test/deploy supported project types through configured pipelines.
items.boundary: Optional when an adequate organisational pipeline exists; not the same as change approval.

items.name: SAP Cloud Transport Management
items.use: Govern transport of supported content across a landscape.
items.boundary: Transport support is artifact-specific; it does not replace tests or database migration design.

items.name: SAP Content Agent service
items.use: Support content export/import and transport integration for supported services.
items.boundary: Not a universal copier for every BTP configuration or secret.

items.name: SAP Feature Flags service
items.use: Control supported feature rollout independently of application redeployment.
items.boundary: A feature toggle is not an authorisation policy or a substitute for schema compatibility.

items.name: SAP Personal Data Manager
items.use: Support data-subject information/request processes for integrated applications.
items.boundary: Applications must expose/integrate the relevant data; purchasing it does not make the whole landscape compliant.

items.name: SAP Data Retention Manager
items.use: Support retention/deletion processes in the applicable integrated scenario.
items.boundary: Business/legal retention rules and source-system implementation still need owners.

items.name: SAP Cloud ALM
items.use: Monitor/manage supported end-to-end business/application operations and lifecycle needs.
items.boundary: Product integration and entitlement scope apply; not a compulsory per-app BTP runtime dependency.

items.name: SAP LeanIX
items.use: Manage architecture/application context and relevant portfolio/governance information.
items.boundary: An architecture tool, not the runtime enforcement of every integration or agent permission.

items.name: SAP Signavio
items.use: Understand, model and improve processes to identify the real change requirement.
items.boundary: Process analysis/modeling is not implementation of a BTP extension.

name: Lifecycle checks before a new selection

items.name: SAP Build Apps — standalone offer
items.use: Understand an existing deployment/contract and its continuation or transition path.
items.boundary: Standalone sale retired on 23 March 2026; do not present it as an unrestricted new purchase.

items.name: SAP Event Mesh — standalone offer
items.use: Maintain/evaluate an existing entitled landscape and migration dependencies.
items.boundary: New-customer restrictions differ from the Integration Suite Event Mesh capability.

items.name: Data Attribute Recommendation
items.use: Recognise the name in older reference architectures.
items.boundary: Removed from eligible cloud-service offerings in March 2026; not a default new-project recommendation.
